findings.summary: No single declaration states all of (B.40). The outer-data order, the tolerance, the Appendix B chain and the late radial-frequency choice are four separate ordered theorems, composed only inside proofs whose statements are bare existentials.
(B_k) is not named in the main ordered statement. Its place after Λ and before C is stated in TransitionRamp.ordered_seed_bounds; the main chain exposes only the resulting T (T_sh) between Λ and C.

After C the Lean fixes the entrance profile and gives, for every later order J and ε, a continuation witness at order max N J. PreparedBounds is asserted only at order N. The paper only says other orders stay finite.
Auditor's open note: the clause on √λ(1+log 1/λ), h ≪ λ, h ≪ e^{-T_d} with C_pre fixed was unchecked, with a suspected λ-versus-√λ mismatch. Checked: the Lean has all three, in the paper's order.
